children: Sulzer has supplied its DEVO purification technology to BeyondPoly’s Version 2.0, 100,000-tonne-per-year polyolefin elastomer (POE) plant in China, supporting production of a material increasingly used in solar panels, electric vehicles, energy storage systems and other advanced manufacturing applications.
BeyondPoly and Sulzer have signed the final acceptance certificate for the purification unit, confirming that the system has been installed, tested and is operating as intended.
The facility has reached its planned production capacity, with Sulzer’s technology performing a key step to remove residual compounds and support consistent product quality.
POE, often described in Chinese media as “industrial gold”, combines the strength and processability of plastics with the elasticity and durability of rubber.
Its optical clarity and high light transmittance also make it suitable for applications requiring durability under changing temperatures and mechanical stress.

"The successful ramp-up and rapid achievement of design production capacity demonstrate the value of proven devolatilisation technology in large-scale POE production. We are pleased to have supported BeyondPoly in bringing this important new capacity into reliable commercial operation while achieving key objectives for product quality, process efficiency and operational stability," said Tim Schulten, Division President Chemtech at Sulzer.

"Our collaboration with Sulzer has been a seamless and rewarding experience. Their equipment delivers advanced technology and reliable performance of the leading quality, while the team’s professional guidance and attentive service exceeded our expectations. We truly value this efficient and trust-based partnership”, said Zhao Yongchen, General Manager of BeyondPoly.

Sulzer said the DEVO system helps achieve low residual volatile content and energy-efficient operation at industrial scale. BeyondPoly selected the technology based on its track record, lower residual volatile content and energy performance.
The project strengthens Sulzer’s position in China’s expanding POE market and provides a reference for its purification technology in large-scale polymer production.
